title: Make loopback-heavy Rust gate resilient to Windows WSAENOBUFS
outcome: The required scripts/test-rust.sh gate failed on Windows while delegation_mcp_tests::delegation_mcp_wait_polls_until_terminal_then_fetches_result attempted TcpListener::bind(127.0.0.1:0): OS error 10055 (WSAENOBUFS, insufficient socket buffer space / queue full). The exact test immediately passed in isolation in 0.11s, so this is classified as an environment/resource exhaustion defect in the parallel test harness, not a product failure and not an unexplained flaky symptom. Investigate loopback socket/ephemeral-port pressure across the 4-thread full suite and make the wrapper or fixtures bound/reuse/retry resources deterministically. Acceptance: repeated required full Rust gates on Windows do not fail bind with 10055, and genuine fixture bind failures remain diagnosable.
